verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a dedicated pricing page (search context, Pro Search, credit-tier rate limits) and lets developers self-serve by generating an API key in minutes without contacting sales, implying transparent self-serve pricing. However the evidence pack never shows actual per-request or per-credit dollar figures, so we can't confirm the pricing is fully itemized/clear from what's provided. Missing for 10: concrete $/request or $/credit rate tables, confirmation that all model/tool usage (sandbox, MCP, agent tools) is separately priced and disclosed publicly.
